# Data Source: catalyst_browser_grids

Read existing SmartBrowz Browser Grid configuration. Requires an explicit organization and `ZohoCatalyst.grid.read`. Returns IDs, names, configuration codes and capacity settings. Credentials, browser connection endpoints, browser sessions, and profile information are excluded. Verified offline.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_browser_grids" "all" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID as a string.

### Optional

- `grid_id` (String) Existing grid's numeric ID. Supply it to return only that grid.

## Attribute Reference

- `grids` (Attributes List) Visible grids sorted lexicographically by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grids))

<a id="nestedatt--grids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grids`

Read-Only:

- `config_type` (Number) Raw Catalyst configuration type code, when reported.
- `endpoint_type` (Number) Raw Catalyst endpoint type code, when reported.
- `id` (String) Grid ID as a precision-preserving string.
- `max_concurrent` (Number) Configured maximum concurrent sessions across the grid, when reported.
- `max_nodes` (Number) Configured maximum node count, when reported.
- `max_sessions` (Number) Configured maximum sessions per node, when reported.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Configured node memory in MB, when reported.
- `name` (String) Configured grid name.
